title: Unify nationality studies on one complete page
description:
Scenario: a complete nationality view
Given a reader opens the Nationality page
When the page presents legacy, expanded-stereotype, and lending studies
Then it keeps those results together as clearly scoped sections and does not render an empty matrix that implies missing results are elsewhere.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Confirmed the apparent blanks came from mixing a seven-nationality legacy study with a thirteen-nationality lending study while a complete 13-nationality stereotype study was stranded under a separate category. Implemented a single Nationality page with three scoped sections and no misleading empty boxes; fresh build and 39 site checks passed. Stacked PR #97 follows the data-completion PR #96.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR #98 merged to main as 27eeb970316825def478d66b70c215e30fce710a. The Nationality page now presents all three scoped studies together without a misleading empty matrix.
